title: Jade - Power over email
excerpt: Jade is email for people who want to be in charge of their inbox instead of defending it.
content_html:
Jade Email

A switch for every sender.
Power over email.

You've given your email to every store, forum, wifi network, and sketchy signup form. They all still have it. Jade hands out a different email for every sender, and puts the switch in your hand.
